Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove under 28 U.S.C. §§ 1441 and 1446, so a plaintiff’s removal is improper and a timely remand motion returns the whole case.

Q5750.reason: Web-only information needs careful use because most people over 65 lack internet access, so it will not reach them.

Q5130.reason: Carotid pulsation does not vary with posture, whereas earlobe waggling, hepatojugular reflux, and loss of the impulse with root-of-neck pressure are jugular venous signs.
